observations.body: Empty nets, washing, a borrowed boat, deep water, and a second lowering establish the fishermen’s setting.
observations.label: Work

observations.body: Simon names the failed night, acts on Jesus’s word, and later asks Jesus to depart from him.
observations.label: Speech

observations.body: Partners help with the catch, fear spreads, and the final word turns from fish to catching people.
observations.label: Call

payload.posture: Observe the work sequence, Simon’s exact replies, the shared catch, fear, reassurance, and final movement.
payload.tension: Simon asks Jesus to depart at the same moment the scene moves toward his own departure from everything.
payload.title: A catch and a changed vocation
